notes: intronIC v2.6.0 default model: mode-separation 6D RBF SVM ensemble (3 seeds x 42 = 126 calibrated SVMs) plus the cluster-aware first-pass ensemble embedded as first_pass_seeds. The first pass scores all introns; mode-separation then performs per-species recalibration (z=(raw - mu_U2)/(mu_U12 - mu_U2)) and re-scores eligible introns with the second-pass ensemble. The classify path gates on n_eff floor + mu_U12 location prior + Fisher-discriminant KDE valley depth before applying recalibration; u12-absent species gate-fail cleanly to first-pass scores. See docs/mode_separation.md for the architecture.
